mapper.sql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(e.name, ''), NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS display_name, u.dept_id AS dept_id, d.dept_name AS dept_name, CONCAT('[', COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT JSON_QUOTE(r.role_name) ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ','), ''), ']') AS role_names_json, CONCAT('[', COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT JSON_QUOTE(r.role_key) ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ','), ''), ']') AS role_keys_json, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS role_count FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN org_employee e ON e.user_id = u.id AND e.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status IN (1, 2) LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id AND d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0
mapper.select: WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.id = #{userId} AND u.id NOT IN (1, 3) AND u.status = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id, e.name, u.nickname, u.username, u.dept_id, d.dept_name LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_impersonation_session SET status = 'EXPIRED', end_time = COALESCE(end_time, expire_time), end_reason = COALESCE(end_reason, '30分钟会话到期'), update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_time <= #{now}
